description:
Set a webhook URL to receive inbound messages and call events.

Pass agent_id to set a webhook for a specific agent (overrides project default). Omit agent_id to set the project-level webhook for all agents.
The signing secret is masked by default. Prefer retrieving it from the dashboard; reveal_secret=true exposes it to model context, transcripts and client logs.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to set webhook for that agent only. Omit for project-level.

context_limit.description: How many recent messages to include with each webhook as conversation context. If omitted, the server's default context size is used.

reveal_secret.description: Print the full signing secret. Off by default: tool output is logged and ends up in model context.

timeout.description: How many seconds to wait for your endpoint to respond before giving up. If omitted, the server uses its default timeout.

url.description: Where AgentPhone should POST inbound messages and call events. Use a public HTTPS endpoint in production.

name: set_webhook

outputSchema.description: The saved webhook (secret masked unless reveal_secret=true).

contextLimit.description: Recent messages included with each event as context.

secret.description: Signing secret for verifying payloads. Masked unless reveal_secret=true.

title: Set Webhook
